# Publish Configuration for `zuraffa_ui`

<!-- Auto-generated by publish-manager skill on 2026-09-05. Rewritten 2026-09-13
     after the 0.2.0 release, which contradicted several of the original notes.
     Edit if the workflow changes. -->

## Package Manager

- **Type**: `pub.dev`
- **Packages**: `zuraffa_ui` (Flutter UI component library)
- **Public packages**: `zuraffa_ui`
- **Private packages**: `cli/` (`zuraffa`, version `0.0.0`, own timeline — not published)

## Scripts

There are no release scripts. Every step below is manual.

## Workflow

1. Commit the pending work on `master`.
2. `git checkout -b publish-<version>`; bump `version:` in `pubspec.yaml` and add
   the `<version>` section at the top of `CHANGELOG.md`.
3. Verify: `dart pub publish --dry-run` must report **0 warnings** and no
   uncommitted files.
4. Verify: `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` (see the test notes below).
5. Commit `Prepare for publishing version <version>`, push the branch, open a PR,
   and merge it (PRs are the convention; `master` is not protected).
6. Tag the merge commit on `master` and push:
   `git tag -a <version> -m "zuraffa_ui <version>" && git push origin <version>`
7. Publish from a **clean checkout of `master`**:
   `dart pub publish --force`
   The machine must hold a pub.dev session (none of the CI paths work — see below).
8. Verify: `curl -s https://pub.dev/api/packages/zuraffa_ui` and check `latest.version`.

## Tag convention

Unprefixed semver: `0.1.0`, `0.2.0`. **Do not use `v<version>`.** The fork
inherited 228 `v0.*` tags from `nank1ro/flutter-shadcn-ui` (e.g. `v0.2.0` is
upstream commit `3441cb8`, 2024-03-18), so the `v*` namespace is unusable for
this package's own 0.x timeline.

## Notes and gotchas

- **CI publishing does not work here.** `.github/workflows/publish.yaml` triggers
  on `v<version>` tags and calls the repo's own reusable workflow via OIDC, but
  its only run ever (tag `v0.58.0`, 2026-06-23) failed, pub.dev automated
  publishing is not configured for `arrrrny/zuraffa_ui`, and the tag pattern it
  expects (`v{{version}}`) collides with the inherited upstream tags anyway. Both
  `0.1.0` and `0.2.0` were published by hand. To switch to CI publishing, change
  the trigger to unprefixed semver and configure pub.dev with tag pattern
  `{{version}}`.
- **`dart pub publish` uploads the working tree, not git.** `.pubignore`
  *replaces* `.gitignore` rather than stacking on it, so anything gitignored is
  still uploaded unless `.pubignore` also names it. This leaked
  `test/**/failures/` (golden-diff PNGs regenerated by every local `flutter test`
  run) into the published `0.2.0` archive. `test/**/failures/` is now listed in
  `.pubignore`; still, delete that directory or publish from a clean checkout.
  `0.2.0` stays published as-is (cosmetic only — the fix applies from the next
  release, since a published version cannot be re-uploaded).
- **The TDD lane stays out of the archive.** `lib/tdd/**` holds the acceptance
  subjects; they drive widget tests, so they import `flutter_test` (a dev
  dependency), and `test/tdd/**` imports those subjects back through
  `package:zuraffa_ui/tdd/...`. Both are listed in `.pubignore` so the published
  package ships neither — otherwise pana flags a test-only import under `lib/`
  and consumers resolve test-runner code into their cache. The lane still runs
  locally, where the mutation audit mutates the subjects in place.
- **Golden tests are Linux artefacts.** `flutter test` reports `+369 -6` on
  macOS x64: the six `ShadSheet` expandable goldens drift by 0.17–0.25% there,
  while the same commit passes all 375 tests on `ubuntu-latest`. Regenerate
  goldens only on Linux/CI. Tracked in issue #7.
- **`check-imports` ban.** `lib/` must not import Material or Cupertino except
  for the app-level shells listed in `EXCLUDED_FILES`
  (`lib/src/app.dart`, `lib/src/identified/app/zuraffa_app.dart`) and must never
  import the package barrels `zuraffa_ui/shad.dart` or `zuraffa_ui/zuraffa_ui.dart`
  from inside `lib/`. Omitting a shell from that list fails the whole
  "Flutter test" workflow on every push (issue #9).
- `CHANGELOG.md` entries carry no date, matching the inherited upstream style.
- `cli/CHANGELOG.md` is left alone — the CLI has its own `0.0.0` timeline.
